## Changes

### New
- Bookmarks can be sorted by unread chapters: fewest first, tap again for most first. Comics with every chapter read always go last.

### Smoother
- Bookmarks tabs slide to the selected tab, like the other tabs in the app.
- A little more space under the stats in Downloads.

### Fixes
- Zoomed in on the vertical reader, dragging moves the page in every direction again, scrolling up and down through the chapter.
